gloss: already; even at this stage; by this point

definitions.gloss: already; even at this stage; by this point
definitions.explanation: Formal or literary expression emphasizing that something has already happened — often at an earlier point than expected, or at the very stage under discussion. A more emphatic and literary form of すでに.

examples.japanese: すでにして⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}していた→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: The problem had already reached a serious stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すでにしてほころび⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せていた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: The plan was already beginning to show cracks.

examples.japanese: すでにして⟦{余裕|よゆう}がない→余裕がない：17325_yoyuuganai⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれている→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}わざる→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: One cannot help but say we are already in a situation with no margin to spare.

notes:
Literary/formal expression combining すでに (already) with ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ (connective te-form). Used in written Japanese to emphasize that a state or event has occurred, often at a notable or unexpectedly early point.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- すでに: already — the everyday form; すでにして is more emphatic and literary
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧: already (conversational)
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧や: by now; as things stand — formal emphasis on the present state
